features.name: Team member management
features.description: List, add, edit (role, department) and remove the organization's staff.
acceptance_criteria: Only tenant staff (no applicant/admin) are listed
A new employee appears with chosen role and department
A user cannot remove themselves

features.name: Roles & permission matrix
features.description: Read-only matrix for system roles and editable custom roles with view/write/delete per permission.
acceptance_criteria: System roles cannot be edited
Custom role permission changes persist
Assigned custom roles cannot be deleted

features.name: Role change audit log
features.description: Record and display the history of custom role creation, permission changes and deletion.
acceptance_criteria: Each change shows actor, time, and from→to per permission

features.name: Departments
features.description: Maintain the organization's departments and see member counts.
acceptance_criteria: Departments listed with correct member counts
Deleting a department unassigns staff and projects

features.name: Staff performance profile
features.description: Per-staff page with decision and task KPIs, open tasks and managed projects.
acceptance_criteria: KPIs match the formulas in BR-CFG-30
Overdue tasks highlighted

features.name: Application form library & builder
features.description: Per-organization library of application forms with field builder, reusable across programs and periods.
acceptance_criteria: Used forms cannot be deleted
Select fields store options
Fields appear in applicant form of programs using the form

features.name: Workflow settings hub
features.description: Settings tab listing programs as entry points to their stages, committee secretary, criteria and form.
acceptance_criteria: Each program of the tenant is listed and opens its configuration

features.name: Communication templates
features.description: Maintain apology, contract and notification text templates with placeholders.
dependencies: REV (apology/close), PRJ (contracts) — consumers to be confirmed
acceptance_criteria: Template saved with kind, name and body

features.name: Reference taxonomies
features.description: Tenant-maintained value lists: entity types, regions, target groups.
acceptance_criteria: Values can be added and removed per kind

features.name: Applicant type registration switch
features.description: Open or close each applicant type for public registration per organization.
acceptance_criteria: Closing a type hides it on the registration page

features.name: Endowment registry

features.name: Organization (tenant) management

features.name: Platform vs. tenant settings separation

rules.rule: Settings tab visibility: «الجهات والمستخدمون» (/admin) is shown only to the platform admin; Team, Roles and Endowments tabs are tenant-only (hidden for admin); other tabs show to both.
Default settings tab: admin → Departments; others → Team. An admin requesting tab=team is shown Departments.
/admin renders only for the admin persona; any other persona sees a notice and a link to Settings → Team.
The Team list shows only memberships of the current tenant whose role is neither 'applicant' nor 'admin'.
Adding an employee requires a name (≤100 chars); email optional (≤255, email input type); department optional.
On employee creation the persona's base role is the selected system role, or 'reviewer' when a custom role is selected; the membership stores the selected role (system key or custom role id).
A user cannot remove their own membership from the team (trash hidden on own row).

System roles (grants_manager, reviewer, project_manager, finance, ceo, committee_secretary) are read-only. Their matrix is derived: View if the role is listed for a permission; Write if listed and the permission key does not end with '_view'; Delete only for grants_manager.
Custom role permissions are stored as strings: 'key' means view+write+delete; 'key:view|write|delete' grants a single level.
A custom role requires a name (≤60 chars) and may start from a copy of a system role's permissions; otherwise it starts empty.
A custom role cannot be deleted while any membership in the tenant is assigned to it.
Every custom-role create, permission update and delete is written to role_audit_log with actor, timestamp and, for updates, a per-permission from/to diff.
The permission matrix is descriptive only: no code reads tenant_roles.permissions or the system matrix to allow/deny actions; access is driven by personas.role in the sidebar and per-page checks.
rules.source: grep of src for tenant_roles/.permissions (only settings.tsx)

rules.rule: Department name is required (trimmed, ≤100). Deleting a department nulls department_id on personas and projects (FK ON DELETE SET NULL).
Templates have a kind of apology (اعتذار), contract (عقد) or notification (إشعار; default) and a required name; the body may use {ref}, {program}, {beneficiary}, {amount} placeholders.
Reference taxonomies are per tenant in three kinds: account_type (أنواع الجهات), region (المناطق), target_group (الفئات المستهدفة); a value is required and ≤80 chars.

Applicant types are a fixed list (association, nonprofit, company, individual, endowment, government, other). Government is internal-only (portal=false) and is not switchable; others are open by default and closed per tenant by a taxonomies row of kind 'closed_applicant_type' whose label is the type key.
Closed applicant types are hidden from the public registration page.
An application form cannot be deleted while any grant program references it (form_id); deleting a form deletes its fields (cascade).
Form fields require a label; type ∈ text, textarea, number, date, select, file, email, phone; select options are split on ',' or '،' and trimmed; new fields append at sort_order = count+1.
Library form fields are shown to applicants after the base data in every program that uses the form (one form reused across periods).
Endowment name is required; description optional. If the tenant has a single endowment the whole plan is counted against it and no split is shown; splits appear only with 2+ active endowments.
Only active endowments participate in plan allocation; the displayed current size is the sum of the endowment's fundings (see PLN).
Deleting an endowment is not guarded and cascades its plan_level_endowments shares.

A tenant requires a name (≤120); contact email optional; status toggles between active and suspended; user count = number of persona_memberships rows for the tenant (aggregate only, no personal data).

Committing a configuration edit requires an evidence document; it is uploaded to attachments/config/<entity_type>/<entity_id|catalog>/<timestamp>-<sanitized name>, and a config_edit_history row stores before/after snapshots, note and actor. If the history insert fails the uploaded file is removed.
An edit session with no differences between the entry snapshot and the current state is closed without saving ('لا توجد تغييرات'); cancel restores the entry snapshot.
Configuration history is append-only (only SELECT and INSERT policies).
The colour palette (clay default, teal, lavender) is a per-device preference in localStorage, applied before render.

Staff KPIs: decisions in last 30 days = application_status_history rows changed_by the person + payment_approvals by the person; completed tasks = manual tasks done; average completion = mean(updated_at − created_at) of done manual tasks in days; open tasks = manual tasks not done; overdue due dates shown in red.

Partner-entity memberships: one person may represent many entities with different roles (primary_delegate, project_manager, finance, member); each entity has one primary delegate; the primary cannot be deactivated before delegation is transferred; deactivation sets active=false and end_at.
Adding an entity team member reuses an existing persona with the same email, otherwise creates an applicant persona; the membership is upserted on (persona_id, beneficiary_id).

Transferring primary delegation demotes the previous primary to 'member', promotes the target (active), records delegate_transfers (reason, method self|donor) and a beneficiary_events 'delegate_transfer' entry.
Inviting an entity sets account_status='invited', invited_email and invited_at and logs an 'invited' event.

issues.description: Permission matrix and custom roles are not enforced anywhere; access depends on personas.role and UI hiding, and RLS allows any signed-in user.
issues.recommendation: Define authoritative role model and enforce server-side (RLS/edge functions) — FR-CFG-009.

issues.description: Changing a member's role in Team updates persona_memberships.role only, while sidebar, home page, task derivation and staff page use personas.role; adding with a custom role silently sets personas.role='reviewer'.
issues.recommendation: Use one role source (membership) everywhere.

issues.description: Endowment delete has no confirmation or usage guard and cascades plan_level_endowments shares (and possibly fundings).
issues.recommendation: Block deletion when used; prefer deactivation (FR-CFG-035).

issues.description: No confirmation on destructive actions: remove team member, delete department, taxonomy value, form, form field, custom role.
issues.recommendation: Add confirmation dialogs consistent with app conventions.

issues.description: tenant_roles and role_audit_log tables exist in generated types but no migration creates them (schema drift).
issues.recommendation: Add migrations with FKs, RLS, and append-only policy for the audit log.

issues.description: Templates are maintained but never consumed; placeholders are documented with no merge engine; no delete.
issues.recommendation: Confirm consumers (OQ-CFG-03) or hide the tab.

issues.description: Taxonomies account_type/region/target_group are not read by any other screen; registration uses hard-coded lists.
issues.recommendation: Bind forms to taxonomies (FR-CFG-029).

issues.description: Tenant suspension has no effect on access, portal or transactions.
issues.recommendation: Implement suspension effects (FR-CFG-039).

issues.description: usePrograms is not tenant-filtered: Workflow hub lists and form usage counts include other organizations' programs.
issues.recommendation: Filter by current tenant.

issues.description: Settings tabs and /staff/$id are reachable by URL for any persona; admin can open tenant-only tabs (team redirected, but roles/endowments render for admin's tenant).
issues.recommendation: Route guards and server checks (FR-CFG-043).

issues.description: FormBuilder ignores DB errors; no field edit/reorder; sort_order may collide after deletions.
issues.recommendation: Handle errors; add edit/reorder (FR-CFG-023).

issues.description: Applicant type toggle shows success toast regardless of write result; closed marker stored in a generic taxonomies table using the type key as label.
issues.recommendation: Check errors; consider a dedicated settings table.

issues.description: Template save with an empty name silently does nothing (no message).
issues.recommendation: Show validation message.

issues.description: Saving a custom role without changes writes an empty 'update' audit entry.
issues.recommendation: Skip save/log when diff is empty.

issues.description: Staff profile is not tenant-scoped and shows personas.role, not membership role.
issues.recommendation: Scope by tenant; use membership role.

issues.description: Most settings tabs lack loading, error and empty states (Team, Departments, Templates, Endowments, Taxonomies).
issues.recommendation: Add standard states.

issues.description: /admin uses its own layout and non-URL Tabs (defaultValue), unlike Page/PageHeader and URL tabs elsewhere.
issues.recommendation: Align with shared layout and URL-synced tabs.

issues.description: Duplicate taxonomy values, department names and template names are allowed; taxonomies.sort_order is unused.
issues.recommendation: Add uniqueness per tenant/kind and ordering.

issues.description: Public registration reads closed applicant types for the fixed demo TENANT_ID only; other tenants' switches have no effect on registration.
issues.recommendation: Resolve tenant from registration context (OQ-CFG-11).

issues.description: Team removal deletes the membership row (history lost) and membership 'active' flag is neither displayed nor managed, though task assignment depends on it.
issues.recommendation: Deactivate instead of delete; show status.

issues.description: Settings tabs in this module (team, roles, forms, endowments, departments) save directly without the evidence-backed edit session used for programs/engines/products — inconsistent governance.
issues.recommendation: Decide which settings require evidence (OQ-CFG-08).

issues.description: Adding an employee inserts persona then membership without a transaction; a failed membership insert leaves an orphan persona.
issues.recommendation: Use a server function/transaction.

open_questions.question: What is the authoritative role source (personas.role vs persona_memberships.role vs custom roles) and must the permission matrix be enforced server-side?
Which roles may access each settings tab (only grants_manager? finance for endowments as matrix suggests?) and which tenant does the platform admin configure?
Where are templates used (apology on rejection, contract generation, notifications) and what is the full placeholder list?
Which forms should consume the account_type, region and target_group taxonomies?
What is the policy for deleting or deactivating an endowment that has fundings or plan shares?
What exactly should suspension of an organization block (login, portal, payments, data visibility)?
May fields of a form already used by submitted applications be edited/deleted, or must forms be versioned?
Should settings changes (roles, forms, endowments) also require evidence documents like programs/engines/products?
How should staff KPIs be defined (include derived workflow/payment tasks, SLA compliance, period selection)?
Should the palette be an organization-level branding setting rather than per device?
In a multi-tenant deployment, which organization's applicant-type switches apply to the public registration page?
Should team membership changes (add/remove/role change) also be audited?
Which identity verification (verified_via) is required before a person becomes primary delegate?
Should removing a staff member deactivate rather than delete the membership, and what happens to their open tasks and stage assignments?
